messages:
Ariane: starting staged rollout v2.3.1 -> 10% EU (edge). change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. tagging eng-sre +oncall. deploy-bot will post updates.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout_id=rl-12345 region=eu traffic=10% target=50% user=ariane. logs: https://deploys/redwood/rl-12345

Mike: @Ariane :eyes: seeing 95p latency jump in eu-west-1 for embeddings on v2.3.1 — 220ms -> 420ms in the last 2m window. not seeing increased error rate though.

Sam: confirming. seeing tokenization CPU spikes on nodes handling long sequences. looks correlated with tokenizer patch in v2.3.1 (tokenizer v4). hypothesis: fallback path not hit for short seqs.

Ariane: pausing rollout at 10%. please hold traffic freeze. can we pin eu-west to previous model variant? if we need to, rollback regionally. @deploy-bot set rollout state: PAUSED

deploy-bot: Rollout rl-12345 set to PAUSED by Ariane. Traffic frozen. Actions available: 
  - regional-patch: /deploy rollback rl-12345 --region eu-west-1 --to v2.3.0
  - route-override: infractl route set --region eu-west-1 --model r-2026-09 --percent 100
See: https://deploys/redwood/rl-12345/actions

Tara: product note: user-facing error rate unchanged, but embeddings latency impacts downstream batch jobs. prefer regional rollback to be safe.

Mike: agree. Sam, can you apply routing override to pin eu-west back to v2.3.0? suggest keeping pin for 30m and observing.

Sam: applying routing override now. command: ```sh
infractl route set --region eu-west-1 --model r-2026-09 --percent 100 --note "regional pin due tokenizer latency regression"
```

deploy-bot: Routing override applied for rl-12345: eu-west-1 -> r-2026-09 (v2.3.0). Operator=Sam. Monitoring metrics: https://telemetry/redwood/rl-12345/eu-west-1

Ariane: thanks. leaving rollout paused. we'll reopen when metrics return to baseline. please add a short line in release notes and changelog about the regional pin.

Sam: metrics back to baseline after ~4m. I'll keep the pin for 30m then roll traffic back to staged config if stable.

Mike: LGTM :thumbsup: also update the release notes and add an eval for long-sequence tokenization to prevent regressions.

Ariane: Added to release notes: "EU: temporary pin to v2.3.0 due to tokenizer latency regression; investigating." Filing a follow-up ticket for tokenizer evals.
